scenario.title: When the agent actually gains Yoke context
situations: Yoke is installed during a live agent conversation
Human opens a harness after terminal setup
Another supported harness is installed later
Hooks, permissions or sign-in are incomplete
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Which native files load at startup, on first tool use and after installation for each harness?
Are installation success, session registration and usable agent context separately proved?
Does each real supported surface load instructions and skill metadata mid-session versus only on restart?
Which otherwise supported feature refusals include the installed-release capability pointer?

lessons.title: Written files are not proof of context pickup
lessons.when: Install finish and first native Yoke interaction
lessons.need: Check native instructions, skills, hooks, session identity and usable permissions in the active harness. Restart/open-folder recovery must preserve the original intent.
lessons.surface: Readiness check, identity read and orientation delivery
lessons.gap: FIRST-USER C/D/E must prove live pickup, not file presence. Accepted scope is the active harness only; GitHub checks are N/A when skipped.

lessons.title: New harnesses and different substrates
lessons.when: Later harness install, upgrade or unsupported operation
lessons.need: Install/repair only relevant native integration. Capability truth is the manifest for the installed release; do not assume every harness supports the same loading or wake behavior.
lessons.gap: Accepted access repair would ship manifests to .yoke/harness/<harness>/manifest.json. Current teaching still names the source-only runtime/harness path.

lessons.title: Recover unsupported or suppressed native discovery
lessons.when: Instructions or a skill are absent in a supposedly wired project
lessons.need: Use the exact discovery refusal/recovery and native verification. Claude instruction suppression, ambiguous old copies, unsupported engines and symlink failures have different fixes. Do not create a duplicate native tree as fallback.
lessons.surface: harness-discovery recovery sections -> native settings/new session and installed-layer refresh.
plan_notes: FIRST-USER accepted installed context access repair
